fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

instruction_languages.notes: Trilingual teaching environment; see language reqs on p. 3.

english_course_availability.notes: Substantial English-taught offerings alongside Catalan/Spanish courses in Humanities, Global Studies, Economics, Political Science, etc.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: CEFR B2 in English (if taking English-taught courses without Spanish/Catalan B1); RHET 1020 waiver not explicitly mentioned.

host_language_requirement.value: Spanish or Catalan CEFR B1 required unless studying under English CEFR B2 track; Idiomes UPF offers reduced-price Spanish/Catalan courses.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Term 1 (Fall trimester): Welcome Sep 17-18, 2026; Teaching begins Sep 21, 2026; Exams Dec 9-18, 2026; Christmas break Dec 19, 2026-Jan 6, 2027.
fall_term_dates.notes: UPF runs a trimester system (Term 1 Sep-Dec, Term 2 Jan-Mar, Term 3 Apr-Jun, 10 wks classes + 2 wks exams each per Factsheet UPF_2026_ER.pdf#page=2).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Term 2 (Winter): Welcome Jan 8, 2027; Teaching begins Jan 7-11; Easter break Mar 20-29, 2027; Exams mid/late Mar-early Apr 2027. Term 3 (Spring): Apr-Jun 2027.
spring_term_dates.notes: Trimester 2/3 structure aligns with UPF Spring semester window.

tuition_model.notes: Confirmed on official upf.edu: incoming exchange students under official bilateral/Erasmus agreements continue paying home tuition and receive a UPF tuition exemption.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Fact sheet p. 4 estimates €800-€1,050/month for a shared flat or €950-€1,350/month for a residence hall.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint 1075 EUR/month * 5 months * 1.1052 USD/EUR = 5940.45 USD (ECB reference rate dated 2026-11-13, collected 2026-11-15: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory accident, travel, and health insurance coverage valid in Spain required for all incoming exchange students (cost varies by provider).

housing_availability.notes: No UPF-owned dorms, but UPF offers assistance via Barcelona Centre Universitari (BCU Housing: https://www.bcuhousing.cat/en) and partner residence hall agreements.

housing_notes.value: BCU Housing Service (https://www.bcuhousing.cat/en) and partner residence agreements: shared flat €800-€1,050/month; student residence hall €950-€1,350/month (total monthly living estimate).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students staying >3 months MUST obtain a Spanish student visa prior to arrival (tourist visas cannot be converted); guide at https://www.upf.edu/barcelona. Lead time/exact solvency threshold not specified in fact sheet.

course_catalog_url.notes: Course offerings are linked per faculty on this portal (/web/humanitats/incoming-students, /web/econ, etc.).

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS (trimester system): normal full load is 20 ECTS per trimester (60 ECTS/year); max 20 ECTS/term (25 in Term 1). Spanish 0-10 grading scale (5 pass).
credit_system_and_load.notes: Trimester maximums (20 ECTS, 25 in T1) detailed on Factsheet UPF_2026_ER.pdf#page=3.

course_restrictions_note.value: Max 1 course/term from outside your assigned host faculty (p. 3); Final Year Projects (TFG) and certain practical internships are excluded from exchange enrollment (per upf.edu).

value: Language proficiency proof (Spanish/Catalan B1 or English B2)
Mandatory accident, travel, and health insurance policy
Passport / Spanish student visa (>3 months non-EU)

academic_style.value: Public university (12,400 students) operating on a fast-paced 3-trimester calendar (10 weeks instruction + 2 weeks exams per term) with 0-10 grading.
academic_style.notes: Trimester structure and grading detailed on Factsheet UPF_2026_ER.pdf#page=2.

campus_type.notes: Three urban campuses in Barcelona: Ciutadella, Poblenou, and Mar.

international_support_services.value: Mobility and Welcome Office (OMA), Language Volunteering tandem program, reduced-fee Idiomes UPF Spanish/Catalan courses, and BCU Housing assistance.

nomination_deadlines.value: Term 1 (Fall): Nomination Apr 30, Registration May 20; Term 2 & Term 3: Nomination Sep 30, Registration Oct 20.
